item.title: 10 Low-Cost Businesses You Can Start Today
item.description: Introduction Starting a business doesn’t always require a huge investment. With the right idea and strategy, you can launch a profitable business with minimal upfront costs. In this guide, we’ll explore 10 low-cost business ideas that you can start today, even on a tight budget. 1. Freelance Services If you have a skill like writing, graphic design, video editing, or programming, you can offer freelance services on platforms like Upwork, Fiverr, or Freelancer.
